scope: Readonly comparison of benchmark_capture.py/final.run.py outputs with portable_source.py, plus power README command variables and timing rules

issues.observed_problem: str(relative_path) produced Windows backslash source_references keys while the verifier requires public POSIX path keys
issues.fix_observed: path.relative_to(ROOT.parent).as_posix() now emits the same two public reference keys on Windows and Linux

issues.observed_problem: Offline command used undefined $benchmark/$programReceipt and the pilot command first used $pilot before its setup block
issues.fix_observed: README resolves actual config paths and initializes repo/python/benchmark/programReceipt/pilot/capture/derived before commands, gives the selected inspection path, and creates the analysis directory

schema_checks.name: root_files
schema_checks.details: Producer and consumer agree on run.json, requests.json, benchmark_source.json, benchmark_commands.jsonl, benchmark_capture.json, captures/

schema_checks.name: benchmark_source_identity
schema_checks.details: Profile, execution policy, original/request/runtime/artifact/host manifest hashes use the same field names; source runtime manifest must be frozen before the live benchmark

schema_checks.name: step_emitted_json_keys
schema_checks.details: runtime.step emits integer slot keys; JSON serialization and readback convert them to string keys 0..15, matching expected_emitted[str(slot)] and final replay conversion

schema_checks.name: host_state_snapshots
schema_checks.details: dataclasses.asdict plus JSON converts prompt tuples to lists consistently. before_step(127) matches run.steps[126].slots. after_step(127) matches run.steps[127].slots

schema_checks.name: target_set_and_filenames
schema_checks.details: Both use positions 32/128, Attention L0/8/16/24/31 and MLP L0. Files are cmd_NNNN_input.bin, descriptor.bin, output.bin and Attention kv_before.bin/rope.bin, each basename with bytes/sha256. Expected sizes are input196608, descriptor256, KV8388608, RoPE8192, published output sizes

schema_checks.name: command_ack_journal
schema_checks.details: ACK hook summary fields command_id/descriptor_words/input_sha256/output_sha256/begin_monotonic_ns/completed_monotonic_ns/completion_receipt/acknowledged match; receipt is copied from the same backend.receipts used by run.json

schema_checks.name: final_snapshot
schema_checks.details: Final snapshot is exposed as benchmark_capture.snapshot with file=kv_snapshot.bin under captures, bytes268435456, sha256, layers[32], generated_from_this_run, reference_match. Both use fa610d68fab6045573a355313f78808c93b7273dbf1edc2e8f61bc3ea1ad81c8

schema_checks.name: program_receipt_wrapper
schema_checks.details: run.programming_receipt wraps path/sha256/receipt/relationship. Inner receipt uses successful all-dsp schema, native returncode0, volatile_sram=true and host_identity. Offline checks retain original Windows host/boot; live power calls current read_program_receipt for same host/boot

schema_checks.name: pilot_D_G_rule
schema_checks.details: Raw sweep.start_ticks nearest-rank p95 gives D=ceil_10ms(max(100ms,1.25*p95)); freeze, launcher and analyzer all use G=3D. Historical150/450ms is labeled historical

schema_checks.name: cumulative_wall_limit
schema_checks.details: Formal sampler MaxSeconds=0 and MaxSweeps=0, fixed_wall_time_termination=false, workload has no cumulative deadline. Pilot duration, per-window acquisition duration, operation/command/ready/heartbeat/close timeouts retain their stated scopes

schema_checks.name: readme_required_variables
schema_checks.details: All required command variables now have setup assignments or a selected-inspection assignment before their dependent step; relative paths follow the config directory

execution_scope: Local source and serialization checks; Dell and board operations remain with the sole native operator
